assertions.assertion: Local open-weight deployment and hosted Open Platform execution are represented as separate admission domains.
PAYG API Key and Token Plan Subscription Key are separate non-interchangeable credential classes.
Commercial plan availability, quota, model eligibility, concurrency and rate limits are dynamically discovered rather than canonicalized.
Billing or credential-class fallback requires explicit policy and an admitted target credential; automatic substitution is forbidden.
Open-weight licence admission and hosted paid-service terms admission remain separate and fail-closed.
Unverified or stale notices about Team plan availability cannot become canonical service state.
